name: Mainstreet Iowa Apparel
old_description: Mainstreet Iowa Apparel specializes in quality screen printed and embroidered apparel. With full graphic design capability, competitive pricing, and quick turnarounds, we provide a full-service experience for your company, group, or organization!
about:
Mainstreet Iowa Apparel operates from Cedar Rapids, Iowa, where it was established with the goal of giving businesses, schools, teams, and organizations a local partner they can count on for custom apparel. The company focuses on quality service and building lasting relationships rather than simply processing orders.

The shop offers screen printing, embroidery, specialty decoration, graphic design, and custom webstore development. A staff of four — Vice President Anthony Hobson, Graphic Designer Curt Zebuhr, Embroidery Technician Cindy Knock, and Marketing and Inside Sales lead Taylor Zebuhr — manages production, design, and customer service from the Cedar Rapids location. The facility includes an apparel showroom where clients can review garment options before ordering.

Clients range from corporate buyers needing branded polos, jackets, and hats to schools and sports teams ordering uniforms and spirit wear. The company also serves organizations that use custom webstores to streamline group purchasing for events and outings.

Mainstreet Iowa Apparel differentiates itself with quick turnarounds, competitive pricing, and a full-service experience that includes in-house graphic design, Pantone color matching for screen printing inks, custom thread color matching for embroidery, and dedicated webstore setup for recurring orders.
